paragraphs: R. Chanina in Sura. Yuchasin omitted mention of him. He is mentioned many times in the Talmud: Berakhot 52b; Shabbat 23b, near the end; Kiddushin 79a; Bava Batra 136a. Rav Ashi said, “Mar Zutra told me: R. Chanina of Sura raised a difficulty in this”—Niddah 52a, near the end. Sotah 2b: R. Chanina of Sura said, “A man should not tell his wife, ‘Do not seclude yourself with so-and-so,’ lest the law follow R. Yosi son of R. Yehudah that a warning may be given on his own authority.” Yuchasin gives this matter as “R. Elazar of Sura said: a man should not say, etc.” This is an error, since R. Elazar of Sura is not found anywhere in the Talmud. See Sotah 25a: R. Chanina of Sura said. Ketubot 63b, near the end: his mother said of his father, “He is repulsive to me.” Mar Zutra compelled her to live with him, and R. Chanina of Sura issued from him.
